pages.title: The camp answers
pages.text: Tribal Weave is the workshop beside the nine Strands. Rhythm, a living landscape and reusable Echo catalysts make its Pulse. Distinct totem voices strengthen the Resonator. No fuel fire is needed.

pages.title: Hands become a workshop
pages.text: Four Echo stations refine batches and accept shared ingredients. Bind can weave Loom Lint into string and Void Yarn into Spiritweave. The Pulse Adapter sends the camp's harmony into standard FE machines.

pages.title: Three distances
pages.text: Cargo rituals grow from Local to Longreach to Astral. Player paths grow from Waystone to Horizon to Astral. March Crystal opens the final tier for both: across dimensions. Built Way Gates and Far Gates are the bulk path: players, mobs and dropped items all pass. Leave both cargo endpoints loaded and a safe floor for travellers.

pages.title: Conduct the camp
pages.text: Redstone pauses stations, storage, relays, the Resonance Mesh, the Stone Font, gate keystones, Rite Pedestals and every generator. Comparators report supplies, occupancy and activity. The Drumheart listens for rising edges instead: 24 Pulse on a 17-to-23-tick edge, 10 otherwise, nothing closer than 8 ticks. Find the full builds in Tribal Weave.

pages.title: The sixth voice
pages.text: Loom joins the five attunements. Loom Thread comes from Ancestor Hall chests, from The Unsung, and from a Loom-stitcher Elder at Friend standing; an Unsung Heart crafts the Loom totem. The Loom Seal blesses Tension in a brazier, the Echo Unweave runs the lattice backwards and salvages worn Spiritgear, and the Sixfold Staff gains Tether and Stitch.

pages.title: Rites
pages.text: Seven Rite Tablets, each two stone and a reagent around its seal (the seal is handed back). A *tablet* rite wants a Rite Circle: brazier in the middle, four pedestals on the diagonals, chalk joining them. Seat four matching totems on the cardinals and the rite costs a quarter less and lasts twice as long. Brazier blessings still need only the seal. Rain Calling, Sky Clearing, Dawn Calling, Green Blessing, Still Night, Ley Binding, and Spring Calling, which marks an adjacent cistern a spring.

pages.title: Bound spirits and camps
pages.text: A Bonding Charm bonds an adult Lantern Fox, Mossback or Dawn Stag: it follows, never despawns, and yields double when brushed. A Camp Charter, or `/tribalpower camp`, gathers players into a camp that shares a vault, its devices, twelve Wayanchors and a quarter of each member's standing. Hearth offerings cap at 60 standing per tribe per day.

pages.title: Reading the lattice
pages.text: The Ley Lens shows the ley where you stand. A Pulse Gauge reads any Pulse holder as redstone; a Pulse Threshold emits at a quarter, half, three-quarters or full. Sneak-use the Spirit Codex on any Tribal block and it says, plainly, why it is or is not working — and on a pattern anchor it draws ghosts for the missing pieces.
